scope_zh: 修正越出高架的隔音屏，补足轨道和设备建筑细节，重做中央御车寄，并新增M7、M8地面楼梯与B1连续连接。

sources.title: Tokyo Metro Tokyo station official diagram and surrounding map
sources.use: B1/B2 topology; ground stair exits M7/M8; distinction between public plaza stairs and exits within surrounding buildings. Entrance coordinates and corridor lengths are fitted to the existing diorama, whose underground frame was already shifted in V11.

sources.title: Tokyo Metro Tokyo accessibility information
sources.use: Ground lift connection is via M10 / Oazo. V13 does not invent an M8 lift or a freestanding M10 kiosk in the plaza. The building-integrated M10 route lies outside this reconstruction.

sources.title: 旅鉄Walker, Tokyo station photographic gallery, M8 exit
sources.use: M8 dark flat roof, glazed side walls, stone landing/retaining wall, handrails and tactile paving. The related M7 pavilion uses the same visual vocabulary as an approximation; its exact facade has not been independently surveyed.

sources.title: RailwayStation.jp, central imperial porte-cochere photograph
sources.use: Round brick-and-stone piers, layered stone entablature, recessed iron gate with radial ornament, balustrade and clipped pine forecourt. Reconstructed proportions fit the inherited station facade; small carving is simplified.

sources.title: pelican, Tokyo Station overhead, 2020-10-25
sources.use: Visible ballast, sleepers, trackside cable routes, independent and staggered catenary portals, service huts. Photo is an oblique view, not a mast coordinate survey.

sources.title: Tokyo Station aerial walk, November 2020
sources.use: Relative roof/catenary and rooftop-service arrangement. Insufficient resolution for one-to-one mast coordinate verification.

sources.title: Existing Google Maps street reference carried forward from V11
sources.author: Ito Imaji
sources.use: Existing V11 north-end utility enclosure retained. New V13 equipment-room end details are interpretive mechanical completion, not an assertion that each louvre or door is survey-matched.

diagnosed_model_errors: V10 Chuo west screen continued to X=229 and east screen to X=221, although their viaduct meshes ended at X=124. New ends derive from actual mesh bounds.
V10 barrier centres used track offset 3.65 m, detached from the narrow deck. New centres use 1.94 m with continuous coping and inward-landing brackets.
The existing ballast crib exposed only about 5 mm of the depressed sleeper centre. Lower the crib by 60 mm; retain rail elevations, rail seats, sleeper locations and track gauge.
accuracy_limits_zh: 这不是测绘模型，也不是所有设施同一日期的复原。
接触网杆位原来按约22米间距并避障生成。V13逐根导出杆位记录，明确未测量；现有照片不能证明全部杆位与实景一致，因此没有随意挪杆或宣称已逐根校准。
隔音屏末端与支座已按模型高架修正；屏高、面板型式和拼缝仍是照片辅助的估算。
M7/M8地面入口及连接通道在模型中实际贯通；平面位置、长度和深度继承并适配V11的简化地下站，不能作导航或工程资料。
M9/M10位于周边建筑内的出入口与完整商业地下网络不在本次模型范围。
中央御车寄及设备建筑的细小装饰、百叶、管线尺寸为解释性几何。
asset_policy: All V13 additions are procedural native Blender meshes. Reference photos are viewed only; no reference-photo pixels or third-party models are redistributed. Original asset and font licences continue to apply.
preservation: Each replaced source object is retained with its original geometry and transform in V13_Replaced_hidden. V12 rolling-stock collections and instancer assignments are unchanged.
